interface.longDescription:
FCIS-GO connects your workspace to the Fountain Coach Instruction System.

Verified work can become reusable procedures with retained sources, evidence and conditions. Fountain Coach maintains the shared technology and canonical instructions. Each customer develops their own working knowledge and governs its use.

Discover the method, examples and source references at fcis.fountain.coach.
